Title: Username field is displayed on the login page
Preconditions: Browser is open. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com in the browser | 2. Look at the login form in the middle of the page
Expected Result: A text input with placeholder "Username" (data-test="username") is visible and enabled.

Expected Result: An input with placeholder "Password" (data-test="password") is visible and enabled.

Steps: 1. Leave the Username field empty | 2. Type the password in the Password field | 3. Click the Login button
Expected Result: An error message (data-test="error") appears and CONTAINS "Username is required". The URL stays https://www.saucedemo.com/.
Notes: PO Q1: assert CONTAINS; the "Epic sadface: " prefix is accepted.

Title: Closing the error removes the error message
Preconditions: Browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty and click the Login button | 2. Check that the red error message appears | 3. Click the round "X" button on the right side of the error message
Expected Result: After step 3 the error message (data-test="error") is no longer visible.

Title: Closing the error removes the error icons from the fields
Preconditions: Browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty and click the Login button | 2. Check that a red "X" icon appears inside the Username and Password fields | 3. Click the round "X" button on the error message
Expected Result: After step 3 no error icon is shown inside the Username or Password field.

Title: Closing the error removes the red borders from the fields
Preconditions: Browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty and click the Login button | 2. Check that the Username and Password fields have a red bottom border | 3. Click the round "X" button on the error message
Expected Result: After step 3 neither the Username nor the Password field shows the red error border: the inputs no longer have the "error" CSS class, and the bottom border is no longer red (rgb(226, 35, 26)).
Notes: PO Q10: closing must reset the whole error state. CORRECTED in stage 3: the earlier "known defect" came from a wrong observation. "input_error" is a base class present from page load; the real error marker is the "error" class, which IS removed on close. PO confirmed in the Q10 update: no defect.

Title: Valid user can log in by pressing Enter
Preconditions: Browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Type the username in the Username field | 2. Type the password in the Password field | 3. With the cursor still in the Password field, press the Enter key (do not click Login)
Expected Result: The browser URL changes to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html and the page title shows "Products".
Notes: PO Q7: Enter is a valid way to log in.

Title: Valid user can log in using only the keyboard
Preconditions: Browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com. User is not logged in.
Steps: 1. Click the Username field and type the username | 2. Press Tab to move to the Password field | 3. Type the password | 4. Press Tab to move focus to the Login button | 5. Press Enter
Expected Result: Tab moves focus Username -> Password -> Login button in that order, and pressing Enter takes the user to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html.
